title: Make the repository database ignore policy explicit
outcome: The Engram migration intentionally defines whether non-.codenav database files inside the worktree are ignored, without silently inheriting an unrelated tracker default.
acceptance: A focused git check-ignore probe demonstrates the intended treatment of .codenav/index.db, legacy Beads databases, and an arbitrary worktree database
The owner-approved database ignore policy is encoded in .gitignore and explained next to the rule
